schemes.name: Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.summary: A credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service/business activities. Banks finance the project; the government contributes a margin-money subsidy. It is not a direct government loan.

eligibility_rules.explanation: PMEGP's main subsidy is for setting up new units. Existing units are generally not eligible; a separate second-loan route exists only for units earlier financed under PMEGP/REGP/MUDRA. Confirm which applies to you.
The official page describes individuals above 18 years of age as eligible applicants. Other entity types are not described in the sources reviewed, so confirm that your entity type can apply.

conditions_to_confirm: Applicant must be above 18 years of age (individual applicants).
Confirm your planned activity is permitted under the scheme's list of eligible activities.
Units that have already received a government subsidy under another scheme are not eligible.
exclusions: Existing units and units that have already availed a government subsidy under another central or state scheme (new-unit route).
benefits: Margin-money subsidy of 15% to 35% of project cost, depending on beneficiary category and whether the unit is in an urban or rural area (general category: 15% urban, 25% rural; special categories: 25% urban, 35% rural).
Maximum project cost admissible for the subsidy: ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for business/service; any balance may be financed by banks without subsidy.
Banks provide the balance of the project cost as a term loan after the beneficiary's own contribution and the subsidy.

required_documents.name: Documents listed on the PMEGP e-portal for your applicant category
required_documents.notes: The catalogue's source notes do not enumerate the document list. Check the portal before applying.

required_documents.name: Project proposal / project report
required_documents.notes: Applications are made for a specific project. Confirm the required format and contents on the portal.

required_documents.name: Proof of special-category status, if you claim the special-category subsidy rate
required_documents.notes: Only relevant if you apply under a special category. The specific proof is set by the scheme guidelines.

application_steps: Read the current PMEGP guidelines and the list of eligible activities on the official portal.
Apply through the PMEGP e-portal as described on the official page.
Complete any training the guidelines require for your project cost.
The bank appraises the project and decides on the loan; confirm the later steps on the portal.
schemes.source_title: PMEGP — KVIC portal, myScheme and Puducherry DIC pages
review_notes: Document list not enumerated in the reviewed official pages; items are marked 'confirm'.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.summary: Loans for non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises, provided through banks, small finance banks, RRBs, MFIs and NBFCs in categories named Shishu, Kishor, Tarun and Tarun Plus.

eligibility_rules.explanation: PMMY targets non-corporate small businesses; a private limited company is not the intended borrower type.

conditions_to_confirm: The scheme covers non-farm income-generating activities (allied agriculture activities are included); crop cultivation itself is outside its focus.
Your loan category depends on your funding need; Tarun Plus is for borrowers who have repaid a previous Tarun loan.
Each lender (bank, NBFC or MFI) applies its own credit appraisal and terms.
exclusions: Corporate borrowers such as private limited companies (the scheme targets non-corporate businesses).
benefits: Loan categories: Shishu up to ₹50,000; Kishor above ₹50,000 up to ₹5 lakh; Tarun above ₹5 lakh up to ₹10 lakh; Tarun Plus above ₹10 lakh up to ₹20 lakh.
Available for new and existing micro units through participating banks, small finance banks, RRBs, MFIs and NBFCs.

required_documents.name: Loan application form from your lender
required_documents.notes: Forms and formats differ by lender.

required_documents.name: Identity and address proof (KYC)
required_documents.notes: The exact documents are set by the lender.

required_documents.name: Business details, business plan or bank statements
required_documents.notes: Lenders typically ask for details of the business; confirm what yours requires.

required_documents.name: Details of the machinery or equipment supplier (for example a quotation)
required_documents.notes: Relevant for equipment or machinery loans.

required_documents.name: Report on the economic and technical viability of the business
required_documents.notes: Sources indicate this for larger expansion loans; confirm with your lender.

application_steps: Decide how much funding you need and which loan category that falls under.
Approach a bank, small finance bank, RRB, NBFC or MFI, or apply through online portals such as Udyamimitra or JanSamarth where available.
The lender appraises the proposal and decides; terms vary by lender.
schemes.source_title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana — MUDRA website
review_notes: Tarun Plus (₹10–20 lakh) was introduced after the 2024-25 Budget; confirm current limits on the official website.

schemes.name: New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS), Tamil Nadu
schemes.summary: A Tamil Nadu government scheme to help educated first-generation entrepreneurs set up new manufacturing or service enterprises, with a capital subsidy and linkage to bank or TIIC term loans.

eligibility_rules.explanation: NEEDS assistance is for new projects sanctioned specifically under the scheme; units already operating or assisted under another scheme are not eligible.
Partnership concerns may be considered if every partner meets the eligibility criteria. Other entity types are not described in the sources reviewed; confirm yours.

conditions_to_confirm: Applicant should be a resident of Tamil Nadu for at least 3 years.
Applicant should be a first-generation entrepreneur.
Age and educational-qualification conditions apply (a Tamil Nadu government page lists a maximum age of 35 years for the general category); check the current guidelines.
Applicant should not be a defaulter to a commercial bank or TIIC.
Trading/retail activities are not listed in the sources reviewed (manufacturing and service enterprises are); confirm if your activity is covered.
exclusions: Applicants or units that have received assistance under UYEGP, TAHDCO or any other central or state scheme.
benefits: Capital subsidy of 25% of the eligible project cost. The maximum subsidy amount is stated differently across the sources reviewed, so it is not specified here; confirm the current ceiling.
3% interest subvention for eligible borrowers, as listed by TIIC.
Entrepreneurship Development Programme training and help preparing a business plan, as described on district government pages (confirm the current format).

required_documents.name: KYC documents
required_documents.notes: The exact list is set by the lender (bank or TIIC) and the scheme guidelines.

required_documents.name: Project report / business plan
required_documents.notes: Confirm the required format with the District Industries Centre or lender.

required_documents.name: Proof of Tamil Nadu residence for at least 3 years
required_documents.notes: The scheme requires 3 years' residence; the accepted proof is not specified in the sources reviewed.

required_documents.name: Educational qualification certificate
required_documents.notes: The scheme targets educated youth; confirm which qualifications are accepted.

required_documents.name: Land title in the name of the entrepreneur or enterprise
required_documents.notes: Relevant where land is part of the project; confirm with TIIC or the bank.

application_steps: Review the current NEEDS guidelines on the Tamil Nadu government and TIIC pages.
Apply through the Tamil Nadu MSME online portal named on the official pages.
Complete training and the term-loan tie-up with a bank or TIIC as the guidelines require; confirm the sequence with your District Industries Centre.
schemes.source_title: NEEDS — myScheme, TIIC and Tamil Nadu government pages
review_notes: Subsidy ceiling and project-cost limits differ between sources reviewed; flagged possibly_changed until a human confirms current guidelines.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.summary: A central scheme of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs giving street vendors collateral-free working-capital term loans through an online portal and lenders.
conditions_to_confirm: Applicants must be street vendors, identified through a certificate of vending or ID card, or through a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from the urban local body (for census towns and peri-urban areas, one approved by the Block Development Officer).
Loan tranche amounts and other benefits have changed since launch; confirm current terms on the portal.
benefits: Collateral-free working-capital term loan for street vendors, provided in tranches, with a higher tranche available after timely repayment of the previous one.
Tranche amounts have changed over time and the sources reviewed differ, so they are not specified here; confirm current amounts on the portal.

required_documents.name: Certificate of Vending or a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) issued through the PM SVANidhi portal
required_documents.notes: Vendors without a vending certificate need an LoR. LoRs must be applied for and issued through the portal; manually issued LoRs are not valid, per a lender page.

required_documents.name: KYC documents
required_documents.notes: The exact documents are set by the portal and the lender.

required_documents.name: Application and undertaking forms required by the lender
required_documents.notes: Lender pages mention an application and an undertaking letter; confirm yours.

application_steps: Check the portal for current eligibility and loan terms.
Apply through the PM SVANidhi portal as described there (lenders and assisting bodies can also help).
Obtain a vending certificate or an LoR where needed, then continue with the lender.
review_notes: Scheme terms were restructured after launch and sources disagree on tranche amounts; flagged possibly_changed.
